title: RFC 9728 OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata
description: Project-derived validation schema encoding RFC 9728 Section 2 protected resource metadata. This schema is not published by the RFC authors.

resource.description: The protected resource's identifier URL (e.g. PDS origin).

authorization_servers.description: List of trusted Authorization Server URLs protecting this resource.

scopes_supported.description: List of OAuth 2.0 scopes supported by this protected resource.

bearer_methods_supported.description: List of bearer token presentation methods supported.

resource_documentation.description: URL of the protected resource documentation.
